t: This is the site of Camelford House, a building whose story here is a quiet one. What we know is that Charles Mills was born here in 1830. He became a British banker and Conservative politician, known as Sir Charles Mills, second baronet, from 1872 to 1886, and was then made the first Baron Hillingdon. He died in 1898. If you're passing, it's a spot to pause and picture a banker's childhood in nineteenth-century London.
